blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — All four members of a family who were buried when a landslide struck their home in Barangay Pulangbato, Cebu City, on Friday, October 9, have been recovered. Three of them, including two children, died. The last victim, the 60-year-old grandmother, was retrieved dead at around 5:43 p.m., completing the recovery operation in Sitio Kandarong Riverside. The other victims were the 38-year-old mother and her two children, aged 5 and 6.
